title: One-to-one rooms use room-policy fixed_membership (max_users 2)
description: Mark 2026-11-21 (decision mimid-1wgh.87): direct rooms use room-policy-04 §5 fixed_membership with max_users 2, replacing the ordinary-room shape of c9d76e9f. Read room-policy-04 §5 rules (participants fixed at creation, no adds, cannot leave, one room per participant set) and implement: the agent creates the room with both participants at creation (a Welcome to the peer, no separate invite step; consent still applies), the hub enforces fixed_membership (refuses adds/removes except as the draft allows; check what 'cannot leave' means for a user removing their own devices), one room per pair (open_direct finds the existing one), and what IRC PART and JMAP Chat destroy do in a fixed room (likely: leave locally / hide, not leave the MLS group; record and ask Mark if the draft forces a user-visible change). Tests across two providers. Record as §7 entry.
close_reason: Done: 0b729c70 on direct-latest (fixed_membership + max_users 2, hub rules per decision mimid-1wgh.89, two-provider test). PART/destroy in a fixed room left for Mark in a human bead.
